title.narrative: In 2024, over 229,000 children and adolescents gained better access to quality education through digital tools, gender-focused programs, and re-enrollment initiatives. Families improved early learning at home with storybooks and parenting resources, while 992 adolescents, mostly girls, built STEM skills, fostering greater equity and future opportunities. A year-long back-to-school campaign addressed dropout rates, encouraging re-enrollment and retention across schools nationwide
